description_excerpt: Crypto Asset Tax Calculation Solution Crypto Asset Tax Calculation Solution The Finnish Tax Administration seeks to procure a production-ready software solution for the processing, analysis and tax calculation of crypto-asset transaction data. The purpose of the procurement is to support tax assessment, tax control, tax audits and analytical activities related to crypto-assets. The solution will be used to analyse cryptocurrency transaction histories, determine the tax consequences of crypto-asset transactions and produce information that can be further utilised within the Finnish Tax Administration’s internal processes and systems. The procurement concerns a software solution capable of importing, processing, analysing and exporting cryptocurrency transaction data originating from multiple sources. Such data may be obtained from taxpayers, cryptocurrency exchanges and trading platforms, cryptocurrency wallet applications, blockchain addresses and other sources of cryptocurrency transaction information. title: Belgium – Advertising and marketing services – European Potato Promotion Campaign
description_excerpt: From 2020 to 2025, VLAM, CNIPT, Bord Bia and Europatat collaborated on the European fresh potato promotion campaign “Potatoes, prepare to be surprised – Europe’s favourite since 1536”. Building on this experience, the four organisations are joining forces for a new three-year information and promotion campaign, co-funded by the European Union. The new campaign offers an opportunity to develop a fresh and distinctive creative concept. While lessons from the previous campaign can serve as inspiration, we expect an original, new approach, without being bound by the branding, slogan or visual identity of the previous campaign. The new campaign wants to stimulate the consumption of fresh potatoes at EU level and more specifically in three countries, i.e. Belgium (Flanders), France and Ireland. Target group of the campaign is people between 25 and 44 years old The communication objective of the new campaign is to highlight the ease of use (convenience) and versatility of fresh potatoes (pleasure) and their place in a contemporary lifestyle and a healthy, balanced and sustainable diet.
